## 2. Reflection questions

1. Which tasks belong on my own computer, which on Raven, and which on Hyak? 
Editing, git, and github belong on my own computer. Raven, the RStudio server, is for interactive analysis and most weekly work. Hyak is for the big data, for anything that Raven can't handle or needs generally more CPU.

Quality control / FastQC
